name: google-comment-responder

defaultPrompt: Respond to unresolved AGENT: comments in this Google Doc.
Draft replies for selected comment threads without posting them.
Scan these documents and report which comment threads need more evidence before replying.
interface.longDescription: Google Comment Responder helps Codex handle existing Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides comment threads with an auditable workflow: scan configured threads, filter eligible requests, read nearby context, draft concise replies, write only to existing threads, avoid deleting comments, resolve only when explicitly asked, and verify writeback.

description: Reusable Codex workflow for safely replying to existing Google Drive comment threads. Requires Google Drive tools/access.
